cases.prompt: Turn this already-agreed feature context into a PRD. Draft the PRD only; do not run commands, create files, or create an ait epic. Assume I approve this implementation shape and testing focus, so do not interview me before drafting. After the draft, briefly state that follow-up implementation tasks should use the future ait epic as their parent/source epic. Context: Users of a note-taking app need saved search alerts. They can save a search query, choose daily or weekly email alerts, pause or delete alerts, and see why an alert matched a note. Implementation shape: add an alert scheduling module, an email notification module, and UI/API changes for managing saved-search alerts. Testing focus: scheduler behavior, notification content, and pause/delete behavior. Out of scope: mobile push notifications, team-shared alerts, and complex boolean query syntax.
